enchantments.tooltip: +15 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +15 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.

Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Quality Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Intelligence.
Quality Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Wisdom.
Quality Charisma +3: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Enchantment Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Insightful Necromancy Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Chaos Absorption +22%: Passive: 22% Enhancement Bonus to Chaos Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
